answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, unlocked only after continuous uptime, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the violet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the beacon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. What survives to the knoll is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
